mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id,name,description,status,reviewed_by,updated_at FROM merchant_stores WHERE merchant_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT merchant_id,name,description,status,reviewed_by,updated_at FROM merchant_stores ORDER BY merchant_id
SELECT merchant_id FROM merchant_stores WHERE status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_stores SET name=#{name},description=#{description}, reviewed_by=CASE WHEN status='REJECTED' THEN NULL ELSE reviewed_by END, status=CASE WHEN status='REJECTED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE status END WHERE merchant_id=#{id}
UPDATE merchant_stores SET status=#{status},reviewed_by=#{admin} WHERE merchant_id=#{id}
